messages:
ana: tiny midweek delight  meet Toast, my river otter, demonstrating the ancient art of 'toastie balancing' (he balances toast on his belly). video: https://imgur.com/a/ToastTheOtter :otter:
devin: this is the single most ridiculous thing i've ever loved :joy:
samir: is that whole-toast or half-toast? important physics question. :thinking:
ana edit: full slice. he insists on whole slices for authenticity. :bread:
lina: also why does he look like he's judging my sandwich choices :eyes:
pet-ops-bot: Friendly reminder: aquatic/exotic pets require prior sign-off from People Ops and proof of suitable transport containers for in-person visits: https://redwood.example.com/pet-policy :information_source:
nana (correction): uploaded still (for slow connections): https://files.slack.com/files-pri/T44444-F99999/toast_balanced.jpg
devin: caption idea: "Toast: committed to carbs and balance" :bread:
samir: poll: what should we call Toast's signature move? react :one: "The Belly Biscuit", :two: "River Roast", :three: "Otterly Toasted"
(reactions: ana :one:, devin :three:)
pet-ops-bot: Poll results: "The Belly Biscuit" 1, "River Roast" 0, "Otterly Toasted" 1
lina: tie! both names are good. also can we get a slo-mo replay next time? my heart needs data. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
nana: will do a slow-mo tomorrow. note: Toast refuses peanut butter but will accept a single blueberry as a performance fee. :blue_heart:
devin: who can resist an otter with standards :laughing:
pet-ops-bot: If planning to bring Toast for a virtual cameo, please register date/time here: https://redwood.example.com/pet-showcase. Reminder: no live water tanks in the office without Facilities approval. :warning:
